dedupe_keys.name: tohoku electric power network past electricity use and area supply demand records tohoku six prefectures and niigata 2016 onwards

description: Tohoku Electric Power Network, the grid operator for the six Tohoku prefectures and Niigata, publishes past electricity use records on its electricity forecast site. The download page gives yearly CSV files of actual electricity use from 2016 to 2026 and monthly CSV files of area supply and demand records by fiscal year from fiscal 2023 onwards, with quarterly files for April 2016 to January 2024; the current and previous month are posted on a separate page until the monthly file is complete. Notes on the page state that area supply and demand and solar records exclude self-consumed solar power, which appears as reduced demand, and that the pumped storage column combines pumped generation and pumping power, except from the first quarter of fiscal 2020 to the second quarter of fiscal 2021, when it holds pumping power only and pumped generation is included in hydro. Coverage is the Tohoku and Niigata service area. Files are free; the operator gives no warranty of accuracy and states no licence. Caveats: past records may be revised without notice and the column definition changed in 2020 to 2021. Simulation uses are regional demand and generation mix time series for adequacy studies, and demand response to heat and cold events. Related records: data-hokkaido-nw-grid-information-disclosure covers the neighbouring Hokkaido system.
